title: Foreign Friends
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 10^5; 1 \leq M \leq 10^5; 1 \leq K \leq 10^5; 1 \leq L \leq N; 1 \leq A_i \leq K; 1 \leq B_1<B_2<\cdots<B_L\leq N; 1\leq C_i\leq 10^9; 1\leq U_i<V_i\leq N; (U_i, V_i)\neq (U_j,V_j) if i \neq j.; All values in input are integers.
